title: Bialgebraic structures on boolean functions
summary: We study several bialgebraic structures on boolean functions, that is to say maps defined on the set of subsets of a finite set $X$, taking the value $0$ on $\emptyset$. Examples of boolean functions are given by the indicator function of the hyperedges of a given hypergraph, or the rank function of a matroid. We give the species of boolean functions a two-parameters family of products and a coproduct, and this defines a two-parameters family of twisted bialgebras. We then try to define a second coproduct on boolean functions, based on contractions, in order to obtain a double bialgebra. We…
